entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of book 'sea magic research materials'
identity: A set of documents, scribbed notes, musings, tidal records, and other esoterica for research into magic.  Using this, you might be able to discover a magical formula related to the sea.
entries.singular: A set of documents, scribbed notes, musings, tidal records, and other esoterica for research into magic.  Using this, you might be able to discover a magical formula related to the sea.

identity: There is a tightening in your throat as the world folds in around you.
entries.singular: There is a tightening in your throat as the world folds in around you.

entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of spell 'The Dying of the Year'
identity: No matter how much it might struggle, in the end, every leaf falls.  This glamour channels the raw power of autumn into an area around you, killing plants and causing rapid decay in anyone caught in the radius.  The damage is <color_red>greatly reduced</color> in spring.
